c: Open Create / Edit Schedule, or My Group Schedules › New. In Define Schedule, select the group, name the shift and set its days and times.
say: Open create or edit schedule, or new on my group schedules. In the first step, select the group, name the shift, and set its days and times. You only see the groups you manage.

c: Add one or more rosters, such as a primary and a backup, with their members in turn order. Each rotates weekly unless you change it.
say: Add one or more rosters, such as a primary and a backup, with their members in the order they take turns. Each roster rotates weekly unless you change it.

c: Choose the catch-all: one person, everyone on a roster, or the group's manager, told when nobody accepts.
say: Choose the catch-all: one person, everyone on a roster, or the group manager. They are told when nobody accepts.

c: Check the members and the escalation. The shift is saved as a draft: nobody is on call from it yet.
say: Check the members and the escalation. The shift is saved as a draft, so nobody is on call from it yet.

c: On the shift, choose Publish: "This Shift is now live." Its rosters now decide who is on call.
say: On the shift, choose publish. The shift is now live, and its rosters decide who is on call.

c: Add a trigger rule, so that work assigned to the group starts the on-call subflow. On pdi2 there is none yet.
say: Finally, add a trigger rule, so that work assigned to the group starts the on-call subflow. On pdi2 there is none yet.
